description: This Java class manages external login keys for single sign-on authentication in OFBiz applications, including token generation, validation, cleanup, and user login handling.

classes.name: ExternalLoginKeysManager
classes.description: Manages external login keys for single sign-on authentication, including token creation, validation, cleanup, and user session management.

methods.name: getExternalLoginKey
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an external login token, storing it in session and request attributes, and maintaining a map of active login keys.

methods.name: cleanupExternalLoginKey
methods.description: Removes the external login key from the active keys map for a given session.

methods.name: checkExternalLoginKey
methods.description: Validates the external login key from request parameters, performs user authentication, and manages user session and cookies.

methods.name: isAjax
methods.description: Checks if the incoming request is an Ajax request based on headers.

methods.name: isExternalLoginKeyEnabled
methods.description: Determines if external login key functionality is enabled based on configuration properties.
